routes.name: C58 / B19 Magadi Road — Great Rift Valley Escarpment
routes.description: Dramatic drop from Nairobi Karen/Bomas (1,820m) down the Great Rift Valley fault escarpment, Corner Baridi hairpins, Olorgesailie Prehistoric site, to the volcanic soda flats of Lake Magadi (598m). Perfect for downhill rally simulation.

routes.name: A104 Great Rift Valley Highway — Nairobi to Nakuru
routes.description: High-altitude transit highway climbing to the dramatic Limuru Escarpment (2,390m) overlooking Mount Longonot volcano, dropping to Lake Naivasha basin, Kariandusi prehistoric diatomite beds, and Lake Nakuru.

routes.name: A104 / A109 Northern Corridor — Mombasa to Nairobi (Tsavo)
routes.description: The economic lifeline of East Africa and legendary rally transit. From sea-level Indian Ocean port across the vast red-earth savannas of Tsavo East/West, climbing continuously to the central highland plateau.

routes.name: A2 Great North Road — Nairobi to Mount Kenya & Isiolo
routes.description: High-altitude mountain road skirting the jagged snowcaps of Mount Kenya (5,199m). Crosses the Equator at Nanyuki (2,050m) before descending into northern acacia rangelands.

routes.name: B8 Swahili Coast Highway — Mombasa to Malindi
routes.description: Tropical coastal ribbon hugging the Indian Ocean shelf. Crosses Kilifi Creek suspension bridge, skirts Arabuko Sokoke indigenous coastal forest and coral reefs to Vasco da Gama pillar at Malindi.

key_waypoints.name: Malindi Marine Pier & Vasco da Gama
